mentions.name: Totem
mentions.description: An offline-first, local-first team all-in-one workspace featuring live collaboration, databases, and agentic workflows. The desktop apps are built entirely in Rust (without Tauri or Electron) and are functional with early users, while the iOS app uses the same core libraries with a Swift frontend and is in TestFlight beta awaiting Apple approval.
mentions.audience: Teams looking for an all-in-one workspace
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm continuing to work on Totem [0], an offline-first, local-first, team all-in-one workspace that features live collaboration, databases, and agentic workflows.
mentions.author: 1024bits
